en: Black‑and‑white image of a monumental bronze statue of a man in early‑19th‑century dress standing on a tall stone pedestal in a park. The figure wears a long cloak, looks to his left, and holds a curved sword resting point‑down. The pedestal bears a relief with military symbols and the name "THEODOR KOERNER". Trees and a multi‑storey building appear in the background, and a wreath lies at the base of the monument.
